canonicalRecipe.fetch: curl -fsSL with Cache-Control: no-cache and Pragma: no-cache before editing
canonicalRecipe.application: Minimum per-provider capabilities; scripts plus origin access granted only to reviewed external provider origins, never arbitrary CMS URLs or same-origin pages.

risk: Unsandboxed cross-origin frames are still constrained by same-origin policy but lack sandbox limits on navigation and capabilities. Same-origin frames with both scripts and normal origin access could remove their sandbox.

cmsPolicy.fallback: allow-scripts allow-forms allow-presentation; opaque origin, no popups, no parent navigation

trustedProviders.https://www.youtube.com: scripts, origin storage, presentation, popups with unrestricted destination pages
trustedProviders.https://docs.google.com: scripts, origin storage, forms, popups with unrestricted destination pages
trustedProviders.https://mysga.studentsgoabroad.com: scripts, origin storage, forms, popups with unrestricted destination pages, downloads

cmsPolicy.trustBoundary: Exact URL origin equality; HTTPS only, default ports only; parent origin must be known and different. CMS cannot override policy. Provider redirects and content are trusted within these exceptions. A new storage-dependent provider requires source review.
cmsPolicy.preserved: Existing src lazy loading, sizing, responsive classes, feature allow attribute and fullscreen option unchanged.
cmsPolicy.blocked: All frames lack automatic and user-activated top-navigation permissions. Unknown/same-origin frames lack normal origin access and popups.

gtmPolicy.reason: Noscript fallback needs ordinary origin/network behavior for image tags, not script execution, forms, popups or top navigation. Normal JavaScript GTM path unchanged.
gtmPolicy.limits: Consent, tracking prevention and third-party cookie policies still apply; no live production tag firing or analytics delivery claimed.
